About JT-EDUVERSE

India's Most Complete Student Universe

Mukesh Kumar

B.Sc. Nursing Student (Final Year) and Founder
Tantia University, Sriganganagar, Rajasthan
EdTech Founder Self-Published Author AI Enthusiast

My Story — How JT-EDUVERSE Was Born

My name is Mukesh Kumar. I am a final year B.Sc. Nursing student from Sriganganagar, Rajasthan. Like millions of Indian students, I struggled every day — searching for good study notes, finding reliable MCQ practice, understanding how to go abroad for a nursing career, and looking for jobs after graduation.

The Problem I Faced

During my nursing studies, I realized that quality educational resources were scattered everywhere. Good notes were expensive, mock tests were hard to find, career guidance for nursing abroad was confusing, and there was no single platform that addressed all student needs together. I spent hours every day just searching for basic study material.

The Dream — JT-EDUVERSE

In 2026, I decided to build the solution myself. With only a smartphone, no laptop, and limited resources, I started building JT-EDUVERSE — India's most complete student universe. My vision was simple: one platform where any Indian student could learn, practice, earn, and plan their career — all for free or at minimal cost.

My Journey as an Entrepreneur

Before JT-EDUVERSE, I built StudyMarket — a notes marketplace where students could buy and sell study material. I also self-published my first book "How to Business" — a guide to 50 side hustle and business ideas for young Indians. Every project taught me something new about building products, serving users, and never giving up.

What Makes JT-EDUVERSE Different?

Unlike other platforms, JT-EDUVERSE is built BY a student FOR students. I know exactly what Indian students need because I am one. We offer MCQ practice, mock tests, AI assistance, job portal, career guidance for nursing abroad, marketplace, and 15+ more features — all in one place. Our goal is to become India's #1 student universe by 2027.

Target

Mission

Empower every Indian student with quality education, AI tools, career guidance, and earning opportunities — all in one universe.

Star

Vision

Become India's #1 student universe with 1 million active students by 2027. Make quality education accessible to every Indian.

What I Have Built So Far

As a smartphone-only developer from Rajasthan, I have built:

- JT-EDUVERSE — 20 feature EdTech platform
- StudyMarket — Notes marketplace with Supabase backend
- "How to Business" — Self-published ebook on Amazon KDP
- Student Care AI — AI-powered student help platform
- Full-stack backends with Node.js, PostgreSQL, Razorpay, Gemini AI

"I believe every Indian student deserves world-class education tools. You should not need money or a laptop to build your dreams. JT-EDUVERSE is my gift to every student who dares to dream big."

— Mukesh Kumar, Founder JT-EDUVERSE
